# sherpa-toolbar

A horizontal control strip: leading zone hugs, trailing grows.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | control |
| Figma | Toolbar |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-toolbar/sherpa-toolbar.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-toolbar/sherpa-toolbar.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-toolbar/sherpa-toolbar.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-toolbar/sherpa-toolbar.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-toolbar/sherpa-toolbar.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-toolbar><sherpa-button slot="leading" data-icon-start="plus">Add customer</sherpa-button><sherpa-button slot="trailing">Export</sherpa-button></sherpa-toolbar>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-density` | `comfortable` `compact` | `comfortable` | comfortable \| compact (tighter block padding) |
| `data-type` | `plain` `bordered` | `plain` | plain \| bordered (adds a bottom rule) |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `leading` | control | the primary action / actions cluster (hugs, sits at the start) |
| `trailing` | content | item count, search, overflow (grows; content pushed to the end) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`bar`, `leading`, `trailing`

## populate()

`{ type? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
